name: 97330 · Corvallis, OR
findings: ZIP 97330 (Corvallis) has 223 nonprofit organizations. 135 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 114 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97330 (Corvallis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 23 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
